notes.title: Book of Korvald OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132380/Book_of_Korvald/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/23168fc4cd830526adb12d799beadc2bc4561bf3.png[/img]

[b]Book of Korvald is OUT NOW on Steam! [/b]Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with a parasitic eldritch entity. Join forces with beautiful warrior nuns, sexy mythical figures and lustful interdimensional creatures to prevent our world from being devoured. Can you contain your sexual urges and fight to survive? 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d3c80a887ca8238abdab5c93b2d5b5898a832691.png[/img]

Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Many written sagas were damaging to the reputation of royal families and expository to the church. So these writings, along with their authors, were aggressively purged from existence. Korvald was one such scribe.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/15b48123089c8e96badd36a288b47601ddd51a32.png[/img]
Korvald's is not a tale of heroism and justice, but of deceit and suffering provoked by powerful religious empires and unseen cosmic forces. His story begins as so many are ended. Family slain and taken from his now destroyed village, Korvald is branded as a heretic and seemingly condemned to death. The true purpose of his capture and torment are part of a much bigger and far more sinister agenda. In his darkest hour, Korvald is approached by Qhroth'un and an agreement is made that will change everything...
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/34357d04c1a657d9fa8a369dea66d188a6eb5296.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/b86b29fe922ffe18811ada8f7d7ccd48f640e7ac.png[/img]
- Over 50 different female characters complete with sexual encounters. All raw, hot and fully animated.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/38fd4b2ffa2893f6a86a66601d87132087cb5223.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/08699a9b705e37b3c59df293d8faf0e5f919c4cd.png[/img]

[b]Maps / Environments / Areas:[/b]
- Each chapter takes place across an entire country, spanning over 30 areas. Starting in Denmark near the city of Ribe, drawing inspiration from the conversion to Christianity that took place around the 9th century in Scandinavia.

[b]Weapons:[/b]
- 200+ different weapons to find or buy from various shops. Axes, Swords, Maces, Whips, Spears, Flails, Daggers, Shields, and Books (yes books).

[b]Artifacts:[/b]
- 30+ different artifacts and special off-hand weapons to equip. You could raise the dead Templar knights as zombie minions, inflict plagues on nearby enemies, and even cause certain NPCs (and even some enemies) to strip naked (because... why not?).

[b]Runes:[/b]
- Korvald will discover the true meaning and origin of runes and runestones. Utilizing his unique insight into this powerful language, he will gain the ability to harness many destructive and helpful forces. Unleash flaming cyclones, lightning storms, arctic blizzards, healing waters and even summon eldritch creatures to aid you in combat.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/64388e27ba7f7491195e40dbedc0a6e1437ced41.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Update 4.24.24
notes.content:
Another update with some small changes--

[list]
[*]It is now possible to disable the second player controller with an option in controller settings. This will prevent the game from detecting inputs or activating a second controller. 
[*]You can now choose to enable a speed run timer in the regular (non-time attack) mode. You still have to be in time attack mode (using the skates) to get the achievements with it, though. :)
[*]When you finish a game, the autosave slot will now reset the end game trigger events and place you back at the mansion's front yard, so if you want to explore more or play mini games, you don't have to start over.
[/list]

notes.title: Boo Party Update
notes.content:
Hey everybody! I've been plugging away at some mini game changes that will hopefully keep us all chill and vibing.

Previously, there were ways to reduce the difficulty of the dance and arcade minigames, but this wasn't at all apparent, it was something you had to poke around a lot to learn. There are some other adjustments (Succu Bouncer now even has a brief tutorial) but the big thing is that if you seem to be struggling, the game will tell you about those options, and some new options have been created for the tubing and workout games as well that should take some of the pressure off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41008592/25c4b15f4ca434c23411d5d5a0bd2dd5b3b91fa4.png[/img]

But, I got a messages from people who'd already had enough, and from the sound of it the last thing they wanted to do is spend more time on those minigames. So you can skip them entirely if you want, with a setting in the option menu. There's no penalty for setting it, or for skipping them. (Well, there is a little time cost if you do it in time attack mode..) So, please play the game how you want.

Also, just a little reminder, Steam's algorithm loves reviews and they're a big help to a game's visibility. So if you don't mind posting a review for this sort of game, please do! It will definitely help out.

Thanks again for playing Boo Party!
